title: Giraffe with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='24' height='45' rx='10' fill='#F4C430'/>
  <!-- Neck spots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='48' r='5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='56' r='5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='64' r='5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='28' ry='16' fill='#F4C430'/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='80' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='86' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='86' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>

  <rect x='30' y='90' width='7' height='9' rx='2' fill='#D4A017'/>

  <rect x='58' y='92' width='7' height='7' rx='2' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <rect x='68' y='90' width='7' height='9' rx='2' fill='#D4A017'/>

  <rect x='30' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='42' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='58' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='68' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M78 82 Q86 78 84 88' stroke='#D4A017' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='89' r='3' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='22' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#F4C430'/>
  <!-- Ossicones -->
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <rect x='50' y='8' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='7' r='3.5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='7' r='3.5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='18' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#F4C430' transform='rotate(-20 26 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='18' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#F4C430' transform='rotate(20 66 18)'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='30' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#E8B830'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M42 34 Q46 37 50 34' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkly eyes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='39' cy='21' r='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='22' r='3' fill='#2A1B5E'/>
    <circle cx='38.5' cy='20.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M36 17 L37 15 L38 17 L40 16 L39 18.5 L41 19 L39 20 L40 22 L38 20.5 L36 21 L37 19 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx='53' cy='21' r='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='22' r='3' fill='#2A1B5E'/>
    <circle cx='52.5' cy='20.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M50 17 L51 15 L52 17 L54 16 L53 18.5 L55 19 L53 20 L54 22 L52 20.5 L50 21 L51 19 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Extra sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='15' r='1' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='24' r='1' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='25' r='1' fill='#FFFACD'/>
